title: Login Revamp
seoDescription: A shipped redesign of Ana Vodafone's login experience across 4G, Wi-Fi, biometrics, and authentication fallbacks.
deck: Making it easier to return to Ana Vodafone, no matter how customers connected.

blocks.heading: A clearer way back into Ana Vodafone.
blocks.left: The login journey needed to work for first-time and returning customers, across different network conditions and ways of signing in.
blocks.right: I was the sole designer, working with product owners and the testing team from exploration through UI testing. The experience shipped after a one-month sprint.

blocks.alt: Solid color placeholder for the Login Revamp overview screens
blocks.caption: Placeholder — final mockup to be added.

blocks.heading: The journey was familiar. The rules changed with the network.
blocks.left: On 4G, the app could identify the customer's number automatically. We also needed to reassure them that using the app would not consume their mobile data.
blocks.right: When customers switched to Wi-Fi, that automatic detection was no longer available. The experience had to explain the change clearly and guide them to enter their password.

blocks.alt: Solid color placeholder for the 4G to Wi-Fi switching screens
blocks.caption: Placeholder — 4G to Wi-Fi journey mockup to be added.

blocks.heading: Returning should feel effortless.
blocks.body: Biometrics gave returning customers a faster way in, while the updated journey kept the right account and login choices visible when they were needed.

blocks.alt: Solid color placeholder for the biometric login screens
blocks.caption: Placeholder — biometric return journey mockup to be added.

blocks.heading: A cancelled prompt should not end the journey.
blocks.body: If biometrics were cancelled or unavailable, customers could continue with another secure login method instead of feeling stuck.

blocks.alt: Solid color placeholder for the authentication fallback screens
blocks.caption: Placeholder — authentication fallback mockup to be added.

blocks.heading: When is the right moment to create a password?
blocks.body: We tested whether password creation should sit inside registration or happen afterwards. The experiment was designed to understand which option could reduce drop-off without weakening the experience; its final result was still being evaluated.

blocks.alt: Solid color placeholder for the password placement experiment screens
blocks.caption: Placeholder — A/B experiment comparison mockup to be added.

blocks.quote: A clearer login journey, delivered in one month.
blocks.body: The revamp clarified what happens when customers move from 4G to Wi-Fi, made returning access faster, and introduced fallbacks that kept people moving.
